title: Recipe detail entry-point wiring
description: Rename the bottom-bar action, remove the stub alert path, add the new callback, and present the meal-plan sheet from the recipe detail flow with the required recipe and scale context.
acceptance_criteria: `RecipeBottomBar` uses the label `Add to meal plan`, keeps the `calendar` symbol, and invokes a new `onAddToMealPlan` callback instead of the placeholder alert.
The button is disabled only when `recipe == nil` and remains enabled for recipes without ingredients.
`RecipeDetailSheet` owns `showAddToMealPlanSheet`, passes the callback into the bottom bar, and presents `AddToMealPlanSheet` with the current recipe, recipe file, and scale context.

handoff_summary.completed: RecipeBottomBar: replaced showMenuAlert state and alert with onAddToMealPlan callback; renamed label; set disabled(recipe == nil). RecipeDetailSheet: added showAddToMealPlanSheet @State; updated RecipeBottomBar call with onAddToMealPlan and onAddToShoppingList labels; added .sheet(isPresented: $showAddToMealPlanSheet) presenting AddToMealPlanSheet with parsedRecipe, recipe (RecipeFile), currentScale, folderURL, and onSuccess toast handler.
handoff_summary.risks: No risks. Changes are confined to the two expected files and introduce no new dependencies beyond AddToMealPlanSheet (already built in B-37884968).
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the button label, disabled state, and sheet presentation flow.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — both files are leaf UI files not touched by sibling beads.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: onAddToMealPlan is a plain () -> Void callback matching the same pattern as onAddToShoppingList; no architectural change. The meal plan sheet guard on store.folderURL mirrors the shopping list sheet guard for consistency.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Button disabled state (recipe == nil vs has ingredients), callback invocation, and sheet presentation with correct recipe/scale context are the key test targets.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: SourceKit reports false-positive CookbookCore module errors in the worktree — these were pre-existing and do not affect compilation.

conflict_risks: None — both files are leaf UI files not touched by sibling beads.

execution_history.summary: Wired the recipe detail entry-point for Add to Meal Plan. RecipeBottomBar now has an onAddToMealPlan callback, uses the label "Add to meal plan" with the calendar symbol, disables only when recipe == nil, and removes the stub alert. RecipeDetailSheet owns showAddToMealPlanSheet state, passes the callback into the bar, and presents AddToMealPlanSheet with the parsed recipe, RecipeFile, and current scale.
